name: False Vigor
body:
School necromancy; Level death mage 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a drop of blood)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 hour/level or until discharged, see text
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

You harness the powers of unlife to grant the target a limited ability to avoid death. While the spell is in effect, the target gains temporary hit points equal to 2d10 +1 per caster level (maximum +15).
